children: The National Highway Traffic Safety Administration moved to reverse Obama-era standards about fuel efficiency for trucks.
The rule created fuel efficiency standards for medium and heavy-duty highway vehicles and work truck engines
The administration, which is under the Department of Transportation, said the regulation restricted innovation and went beyond Congress' intent.
The NHTSA said its authority is limited to regulating the fuel efficiency of vehicles, not standalone engines or vehicle subcomponents.

The NHTSA is implementing an interpretive rule, which establishes a legal foundation for a forthcoming notice-and-comment rulemaking to officially reset the program for medium and heavy-duty vehicles.
